If Unionism teto save itself, it will only be by the unions standing solidly together, shoulder te shoulder, on the ground that the principle which is really at stake behind some of the struggle. between Capital and Labour is that of trader UniOnlilln it- i self. Working men harem n :he political alliance of Liberal Unionists and Conservative., an eminent ea- ample, where, for the purpose of defeating Moose Itulo,theee two parties atand together awl swallow • good many nauteoue potions at the hands of each other.
